truth.title: pure-esm-and-node-version-requirements
truth.content: The project is pure ESM: package.json declares "type": "module", so the backend, scripts, and config files all use import/export rather than require. It requires Node ^20.19.0 || >=22.12.0 through the engines field, and .nvmrc pins the development runtime to 24.15.0.
truth.notes: The version floor matches what Vite 8 and the toolchain require.

truth.title: css-modules-camelcase-convention
truth.content: Frontend styling uses CSS Modules: each component pairs with a *.module.css file that Vite scopes locally. The Vite config sets css.modules.localsConvention to camelCaseOnly, so a kebab-case class such as .truth-card is referenced from TypeScript as styles.truthCard while the CSS keeps its kebab-case names.
truth.notes: classnames is used to combine these scoped class names conditionally.

truth.title: vite-dev-proxy-and-concurrently
truth.content: Local development runs two processes through the concurrently package (npm start): a Vite dev server for the frontend and the Express server on port 3000. The Vite config proxies /api to http://localhost:3000, so the single-page app talks to the backend in dev without CORS issues, while in production the same Express server serves the built dist/ assets directly.
truth.notes: node --watch is used to restart the server on backend changes.

truth.title: typescript-is-typecheck-only
truth.content: TypeScript is configured with noEmit and strict (target ES2023, moduleResolution bundler), so it only type-checks; Vite (esbuild for transpilation, Rollup for bundling) produces the actual dist/ output. allowJs is enabled so plain .js modules such as frontend/src/truthsXmlCore.js can coexist with and be imported by the .ts sources.
truth.notes: The frontend tsconfig extends the root one and adds vite/client and node types.

truth.title: git-diff-driver-bootstrapped-by-prepare
truth.content: The diff driver for truth XML files is bootstrapped per-clone by the prepare npm script (scripts/setup-git-textconv.js), which adds include.path=../.gitconfig to the local .git/config. git refuses to let a repository commit the command a diff driver runs, so that command lives in the committed .gitconfig fragment and each clone only wires in the include. The script is a no-op when there is no .git directory, for example when truths is installed as a dependency from the registry.
truth.notes: .gitattributes binds truths.xml / truths-*.xml to the truths-canon diff driver.
